name: skillbox-core
description: Evidence-backed YouTube research from the open-source Skillbox engine: channel snapshots, outliers, keyword volume, competition difficulty, SEO scorecards, content gaps, keyword verdicts and transcripts. Every result is labelled MEASURED / INFERRED.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Smoke-test the tool. Returns pong and the engine version.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Channel snapshot: every tab count (videos/shorts/shows/playlists/community) plus the About section (subs, description, keywords). Fast.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Channel handle (with or without @) or channel URL.

tools.name: latest
tools.description: Most recent uploads (reverse chronological), with durations and view counts.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: outliers
tools.description: Videos that dramatically outperform the channel's own subscribed baseline (views/subs ratio) — the best source of repeatable ideas.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: scorecard
tools.description: SEO checklist for one video: title, keyword-in-title, description, tags, chapters, freshness. Returns 0-100 and per-check results.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: keywords
tools.description: Keyword ideas + relative demand index from YouTube suggest (weighted by position) and DuckDuckGo. 0-100 opportunity score per idea.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Two-letter region code used for locale-pinned YouTube search.

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Language code used for locale-pinned YouTube search.

tools.name: compete
tools.description: Competition difficulty 0-100 for a keyword from the live SERP. Higher = harder. Views(35) authority(25) titles(20) entrenchment(15) velocity(5).

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description: Deterministic GO / MAYBE / SKIP verdict for a keyword opportunity based on opportunity vs competition scores you supply (from keywords + compete).

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos matching a query (locale-pinnable).

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: gap
tools.description: Keyword gap: ideas similar to a seed where your competitor's channel already holds keywords you don't. Straight from metadata.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: home
tools.description: Home-tab shelves for a channel: featured video, Shorts, playlists, posts and Featured Channels (with URLs).

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Include the shelf item lists in the response.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Fetch manual or auto captions, preferring the original spoken language plus English. Returns transcript text and timestamped caption segments for script, chapter, Shorts and edit workflows.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: hookscore
tools.description: Deterministically score generated hook copy using the upstream five-property heuristic. Scores are copy diagnostics, not retention or performance predictions.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: title_lint
tools.description: Lint title text against the upstream Skillbox title checks: length, mobile truncation, wording, concrete anchors and optional thumbnail duplication. Scores are heuristics, not CTR predictions.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

parameters.name: thumbnail_text
parameters.description: Optional thumbnail copy to check for repeated wording.

tools.name: channel_dna
tools.description: Infer a channel's dominant content niche from representative published videos. Titles, transcripts and descriptions outweigh tags; one-off topics are reported as experiments, not the channel identity.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

parameters.name: videos_json
parameters.description: JSON array of up to 50 published video objects with title and optional description, transcript, tags, URL, ID, views and format.

parameters.name: preferences
parameters.description: Optional creator-confirmed niche, goals or preferences.

tools.name: retention
tools.description: Parse a pasted YouTube Studio retention CSV and calculate hook leak, cliffs and average slide from the actual axis. Does not invent timestamps from percent-only data.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

parameters.name: csv
parameters.description: Raw CSV text from the YouTube Studio audience-retention export.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Video duration in seconds; required for seconds-based slide rates from percentage-position exports.

tools.name: track
tools.description: Check where a video appears for a keyword in YouTube search and compare with saved position history. Results are locale-specific and only exist after a successful measurement.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: trends
tools.description: Read historical keyword-demand snapshots saved by previous keyword research runs. Returns no trend until history exists.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: channel
tools.description: List a channel's recent uploads from the videos, Shorts or livestreams tab. Optional duration and full metadata enrichment.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

parameters.name: with_duration
parameters.description: Enrich rows with duration in seconds.

parameters.name: full_meta
parameters.description: Enrich rows with full video metadata.

tools.name: posts
tools.description: Fetch recent public YouTube Community posts from a channel, including text, author, publication label and available likes/attachments.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: shows
tools.description: List public YouTube Shows (episode collections) from a channel.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: playlist
tools.description: List public videos in a YouTube playlist.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.

tools.name: info
tools.description: Fetch public metadata for one YouTube video: views, likes, date, duration, tags, categories and description excerpt.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Matrix Agent ID used by the host to route this call. The host injects it; if it did not, pass one of the online_clients IDs from the error payload. The engine ignores this argument.
